component.name: Axel Launcher
component.summary: Minecraft: Java Edition launcher for profiles and modpacks
Лаунчер Minecraft: Java Edition для сборок и модпаков

description.p: Open-source launcher for Minecraft: Java Edition. Create your own profiles or install modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge, keep worlds safe outside profiles, roll back changes and play with friends in rooms.
Открытый лаунчер Minecraft: Java Edition. Свои сборки и модпаки с Modrinth и CurseForge, миры хранятся отдельно от сборок, откат изменений и игра с друзьями в комнатах.
Not an official Minecraft product. Not approved by or associated with Mojang or Microsoft.
